apps.name: GainFrame: Gym Progress Photos
apps.store_desc:
See what’s actually changing in your physique.

GainFrame turns progress photos into body-fat estimates, muscle-group insights, side-by-side comparisons, and an AI Coach grounded in your real check-ins—not generic fitness advice.

FROM PHOTO TO PROOF

• Compare any two check-ins side by side
• See body-fat, weight, and physique-score changes together
• Open an AI Deep Dive that explains what changed—and why
• Review 12 muscle groups across front and back poses

AN AI COACH THAT KNOWS YOUR DATA
apps.description: GainFrame turns repeat progress photos into a visual trend so the transformation has more proof than scale weight.

apps.name: Happy Scale
apps.store_desc:
Dieting is hard enough. But when you work hard, hop on the scale, and see a number that’s higher than yesterday? Well, that’s just not fair!

It’s time to tame the scale!

Happy Scale helps you make sense of the frustrating ups and downs of weigh-ins by using mathematical analysis to make sense of your scale weights.

You’ll:
• understand your true trend,
• take the sting out of plateaus, and
• be able to predict what you’ll weigh for an upcoming event
